Author: Saagi
Name: Achieve Ex+
Description: Experimental Ex+ branch build. Branch is based on val-experimental and uses native Achievement UI opens instead of direct progress requests for local agent/dev-plugin testing before any published release.

TestingChangelog: Experimental Ex+ local layout build. Main pane can show Templates, Categories, Achievement search, and Tracked achievements as columns. Eye toggles templates; Book toggles category/search columns; toolbar is Update All, Auto update, Eye, Book.
